# uptimekuma_monitor_push (Resource)

A passive monitor. Uptime Kuma waits to be called at `/api/push/<push_token>` and marks the monitor down when no heartbeat arrives within the interval.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A push monitor waits to be called instead of probing anything. The cron job or
# worker being watched calls push_url on every successful run.
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_push" "nightly_backup" {
  name     = "Nightly backup"
  interval = 86400
}

output "backup_heartbeat_url" {
  value = "https://kuma.example.com${uptimekuma_monitor_push.nightly_backup.push_url}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Friendly name shown in the Uptime Kuma dashboard.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is running. Set to false to pause it. Default: true.
- `description` (String) Description of the monitor.
- `interval` (Number) Seconds between checks. Default: 60.
- `max_retries` (Number) How many times to retry before marking the monitor down. Default: 0.
- `notification_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the notification channels to trigger for this monitor.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the parent group monitor. Use with `uptimekuma_monitor_group`.
- `push_token` (String) Token embedded in the push URL. Generated by Uptime Kuma when not set.
- `resend_interval` (Number) Resend the notification every N checks while the monitor stays down. 0 disables resending. Default: 0.
- `retry_interval` (Number) Seconds between retries after a failure. Defaults to the value of `interval`, matching the Uptime Kuma web UI.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags attached to this monitor. Uptime Kuma stores these as separate associations, so the provider reconciles them after saving the monitor itself. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `timeout` (Number) Request timeout in seconds.
- `upside_down` (Boolean) Invert the result: a reachable service counts as down. Default: false.
- `weight` (Number) Sort weight in the dashboard; higher sorts first.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the monitor, assigned by Uptime Kuma.
- `push_url` (String) Path the monitored service should call, relative to the Uptime Kuma base URL.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Required:

- `tag_id` (Number) ID of the tag, from `uptimekuma_tag`.

Optional:

- `value` (String) Optional per-monitor value for the tag, for example an environment name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Monitors, tags, notifications and the rest are imported by their numeric ID,
# which is visible in the Uptime Kuma URL when you open the object.
terraform import uptimekuma_monitor_push.example 18
```
